title: Reduce P104 chart-127 suffix by 119 events and 2,510 scalar units (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Finite exact circuit certificate and scoped substitution proof, produced by Nick Petalas. A new chart-127 circuit for selected PR6030 saves 119 events and 2,510 units of the retained scalar allowance.

```diff
- local events 2970; scalar allowance 25988
+ local events 2851; scalar allowance 23478
- complete word: 22803 events; scalar allowance 189428
+ complete word: 22684 events; scalar allowance 186918
```

The interval is `[17461,20431)`, disjoint from CubeJerry's first-prefix construction in #6116. Every permutation and scale is charged. Full arbitrary-entry matrix equality, existing storage and the ordered non-scalar events are preserved. This is a local circuit result, with **no new kappa**, supplier admission or selected-frontier update.

[Package and scoped proof](research/p104-chart127-suffix/README.md). Credit CubeJerry #6116 for the whole-block synthesis approach and second-block question, DreamingOfClouds #6030/#5907, Ali Romman's retained word/checker lineage, Matarener #5975, Mason Hale #5811 and all retained P104/native/compiler contributors. Classical row sharing and elimination are credited as such.

The [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19242050) initially named `[17461,22795)` as one chart-127 suffix. The [scope update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19242077) records the intervening chart-245 ADD and the narrower delivered block. That boundary is preserved. The first improving candidate was frozen; no other blocks or pivot orders were searched.

## Evidence

- A separate integer-row engine checks all 297,025 coefficients of the 545-by-545 local matrices, including role 758, which the new circuit leaves untouched. Both exact local intermediate row-l1 maxima are 67.
- The source-authenticated complete-word interpreter checks the new circuit's full 799-row endpoint, chronological frames, 770 public inputs, 29 owned fields, 31 owned lifetimes and peak 13 owned fields. The recursive paid and productive target profiles are unchanged.
- Eleven negative controls, the hand-computed two-role positive fixture and inverse-block equality pass.
- Both warning-strict registered commands passed locally on CPython 3.12.15/macOS arm64, in 0.99 and 1.02 seconds, below their individual 180-second caps. These are timeout measurements, not performance comparisons.
- Package metadata/replay, exact committed-byte/full-source-history preflight and official nine-file export integrity pass. Normal and optimized Git-free replays with empty PATH and files marked read-only pass; all ten exported files, including the export manifest, retain identical hashes.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p104-chart127-suffix/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/p104-chart127-suffix/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-chart127-suffix
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-chart127-suffix --check-source-history
```

An equivalent CPython 3.12 installation can replace the local path; only its standard library is needed. Expected direct output is `PASS_P104_CHART127_SUFFIX events=2970->2851 allowance=25988->23478 matrix=545x545 full_word=22684 controls=11`. Add `--receipt /absolute/external/path/result.json` or `--emit-word /absolute/external/path/WORD.json` to generate hash-bound evidence or the complete candidate outside the checkout. Default checks write nothing.

Scientific base: canonical main `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, priority revision 8. Both live inputs are pinned main-tree files. Pending #6116 is cited context; no pending executable or unmerged Git-history dependency is required. No predecessor scientific replay was run as an audit deliverable.

## Limitations

The signed recursive moment is unchanged. Complete native, physical-caller, compiler, rounded precision, stock, tape and outer cold replays were not run. No optimality or measured runtime gain is claimed. All five framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No combined circuit containing #6116's prefix is claimed or tested.

## Open next questions

- Combine the disjoint replacements here and in #6116 in one source-bound word, then complete native/caller/precision integration. Pending independent review and that full replay remain blockers.
- Specify a changed paid/helper trajectory that uses the smaller ordinary allowance, with arbitrary-dirty restoration and a complete signed invoice. No such construction is supplied here.

## Related open work

- #6112 speeds selected PR6030 native replay; this contribution changes an ordinary scalar circuit and makes no replay-runtime comparison.
- #6115 studies the selected deferred-layer and BIT-stock transfer; those costs and theorem obligations are unchanged here.
- #6110 binds selected outer predicates to written sources; no outer predicate changes here.
- #6109 binds the selected compiler and outer ledger; this local circuit does not discharge that compiler contract.
- #6108 studies carrier corrections and a distinct PR5907 scalar witness; this replacement preserves the PR6030 endpoint and paid/helper paths.
- #6088 studies two non-carrier corrections at helper572's earlier chart seam; the present interval starts later and changes no helper capture.
- #6084 studies receiver recoding for helper469's frame593 rung; this circuit removes no rung and changes no transport.
- #6069 studies fixed-word carrier and endpoint exclusions; this circuit preserves every whole-block endpoint and recursive interface.
- #6067 studies combination-carrier corrections on the selected word; this circuit changes only a same-chart scalar realization.
- #6045 studies inserted carrier corrections; no such insertion or changed helper target occurs here.
- #6043 audits the original PR6030 word; this package constructs a distinct scalar substitute and does not repeat that audit.

- #6130 proves a restored source-gauge threshold in ADD-once bipartite shears under a scalar-allowance tariff. This contribution instead changes the full arithmetic circuit of one PR6030 matrix; its 2,510-unit saving is not an optimum for that restricted gauge model.

The completion refresh inspected all twelve other open account PRs created since the CLAIM: #6123, #6124, #6125, #6126, #6127, #6128, #6129, #6130, #6131, #6132, #6134 and #6135. They concern centre kernels, samplers, leaf laws, Gaussian bounds, Walsh error, source gauges, ADDRESS characters, random queries and verifier serialization. The adjacent scalar-allowance result #6130 is distinguished above. None reports a competing value for this chart-127 interval or its replacement circuit. No additional mathematical computation was run to compare them.

No competing numerical quantity from these PRs was recomputed for comparison. Live claims/open bodies, exact main-tree terms and merged PR searches were refreshed before commit; sparse local and arbitrary historical-diff coverage remains incomplete.

## CI notes

**Uncertified by CI** at contribution commit `804d25e8a868354134b6e3dc635356a3a0dbf064`. In [run 40694190103](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40694190103), [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40694190103/job/122836479189) failed in Onboarding helper tests and [replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40694190103/job/122838932526) was skipped. **The package replay did not run in CI.** This hosted run certified none of the package's scientific checks. All registered commands and publication/export checks passed locally, as reported above.

The failure is inherited from main `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, the PR6030 kappa-admission commit pushed with `[skip ci]`. The selected record changed without matching the documentation format/navigation expected by these two tests:

- `test_research_current_status.CurrentStatusTests.test_current_section_matches_selected_record` expects the exact marker `**0.003125804**` in `docs/research/current-status.md`. The document instead bolds the longer expression `0.003125804 = 781451/250000000`, so that substring is absent.
- `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` expects `make frontier6030-verify` in the CI navigation document. The test source reads `docs/ci-verification.md`, which still describes PR5599 and `make frontier5599-verify`. This is the actual checked path; there is no `docs/ci.md` at the pinned base.

The failed-job log reports 678 tests, two failures and 23 skips. [PR #6120's run 40691776027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40691776027) has the same two failure names and expected-marker failures, confirmed from its log. Incidental negative-fixture diagnostics are not additional test failures. This package changes neither failing document nor the selected record and did not cause either failure.

**A maintainer re-run is required after main is fixed.** The checks were read once at completion. No branch push, main-documentation change or CI re-run was performed for this blocker. Local passing evidence remains separate from the missing hosted certification.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package. Seven files are added in one scoped directory. Shared code, predecessor packages, frozen evidence and the selected frontier are unchanged.
